body: Founder redirected 'add Adelle' (zero TYLER anchor) to 'replace adelle with Cain' -- Cain already has real lore (#80): killed Abel, cursed to wander, marked so no one could kill him in turn, founded the first city anyway. Full kit: passive flat armor, Q execute-scaled bolt, W dash-away+cleanse, R survive-floor panic button. ARENA_HERO_COUNT 20->21. Real bug found and fixed in the same pass: with 21 heroes exceeding the 20-player lobby size for the first time, the existing owner%hero_count auto-draft scheme could never produce Cain's hero_id in a full lobby -- confirmed live, not guessed. First fix attempt (per-bot random offset) introduced a duplicate-pick risk; corrected to a shared offset derived from the match's own port (zero coordination, zero duplicates). Verified live: a real match drafted all 20 distinct heroes with zero duplicates, Cain included. 5 new tests, full suite (299 checks), VS0/VS1 stable. Commit 9ddba5d.
title: Cain, 21st hero (S170-105) + fixed a real draft-exclusion bug found live
